name: cue
description: CUE - familiada party game (TV + admin + player buzzers)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cue/shared && tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json
